name: PCA9505 I/O Expander
description: The PCA9505 component lets you use the NXP **PCA9505** and **PCA9506** I/O expanders in ESPHome using the [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) for communication. Both chips provide **40** I/O pins and share the same command interface, so either can be used with this component.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the expander. Defaults to `0x20`.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The id to use for this `pca9505` component.

config_entries.label: Interrupt Pin
config_entries.description: The pin connected to the INT output of the expander. When configured, the component only reads the chip after a pin actually changes, instead of polling it on every loop, which cuts I²C traffic considerably. INT is active low and open drain, so a pull-up resistor is required. Must be an internal GPIO pin, not another expander pin.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.
